value.value: Brillouin-function curvature gives a lower-bound effective spin/domain estimate; actual domains may be much larger and may contain walls. These are not measured grain dimensions or counts of particles in the SEM image.

value.value: Aggregation may introduce fusion-interface defects providing carriers for double exchange, RKKY or Zener coupling, while larger domains raise anisotropy barriers. These mechanisms are proposed, with experiments still in progress.

value.value: The authors attribute room-temperature ferromagnetism to substitutional dopants rather than segregated phases, using unchanged diffraction and low-temperature aggregation. This is their interpretation of the reported evidence, not an independent modern verification.

quality.review_scope: All14 main and4 matched SI pages text-read and visually inspected with independent source, canonical, molecular, reader and apparatus audits. Separate pure/doped routes, postprocessing, surface-bound control, magnetic aggregates and theoretical models retain distinct sample scopes. Missing parameters and source conflicts remain explicit; cited external works not independently inspected.
missing_fields: Per-specimen synthesis batches and complete links between nominal feed doping and measured incorporation are not given.
Several workup volumes, separation hardware, stirring speed, aging times, TOPO/powder ratio and exact purification cycles are unreported.
No measured atomic coordinate file, sample-specific refined dopant occupancy, raw spectral array or full statistical error model is supplied.
